You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From b92675f4a9c02dd78052645597dac9e270679ddf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Benjamin Peterson <benjamin@python.org>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2019 20:36:25 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] perf trace beauty ioctl: Fix off-by-one error in cmd->string
 table

While tracing a program that calls isatty(3), I noticed that strace
reported TCGETS for the request argument of the underlying ioctl(2)
syscall while perf trace reported TCSETS. strace is corrrect. The bug in
perf was due to the tty ioctl beauty table starting at 0x5400 rather
than 0x5401.

Committer testing:

  Using augmented_raw_syscalls.o and settings to make 'perf trace'
  use strace formatting, i.e. with this in ~/.perfconfig

  # cat ~/.perfconfig
  [trace]
	add_events = /home/acme/git/linux/tools/perf/examples/bpf/augmented_raw_syscalls.c
	show_zeros = yes
	show_duration = no
	no_inherit = yes
	show_timestamp = no
	show_arg_names = no
	args_alignment = 40
	show_prefix = yes

  # strace -e ioctl stty > /dev/null
  ioctl(0, TCGETS, {B38400 opost isig icanon echo ...}) = 0
  ioctl(1, TIOCGWINSZ, 0x7fff8a9b0860)    = -1 ENOTTY (Inappropriate ioctl for device)
  ioctl(1, TCGETS, 0x7fff8a9b0540)        = -1 ENOTTY (Inappropriate ioctl for device)
  +++ exited with 0 +++
  #

Before:

  # perf trace -e ioctl stty > /dev/null
  ioctl(0, TCSETS, 0x7fff2cf79f20)        = 0
  ioctl(1, TIOCSWINSZ, 0x7fff2cf79f40)    = -1 ENOTTY (Inappropriate ioctl for device)
  ioctl(1, TCSETS, 0x7fff2cf79c20)        = -1 ENOTTY (Inappropriate ioctl for device)
  #

After:

  # perf trace -e ioctl stty > /dev/null
  ioctl(0, TCGETS, 0x7ffed0763920)        = 0
  ioctl(1, TIOCGWINSZ, 0x7ffed0763940)    = -1 ENOTTY (Inappropriate ioctl for device)
  ioctl(1, TCGETS, 0x7ffed0763620)        = -1 ENOTTY (Inappropriate ioctl for device)
  #

Signed-off-by: Benjamin Peterson <benjamin@python.org>
Tested-by: Arnaldo Carvalho de Melo <acme@redhat.com>
Cc: Alexander Shishkin <alexander.shishkin@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Jiri Olsa <jolsa@redhat.com>
Cc: Namhyung Kim <namhyung@kernel.org>
Cc: Peter Zijlstra <peterz@infradead.org>
Fixes: 1cc47f2d46206d67285aea0ca7e8450af571da13 ("perf trace beauty ioctl: Improve 'cmd' beautifier")
Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/20190823033625.18814-1-benjamin@python.org
Signed-off-by: Arnaldo Carvalho de Melo <acme@redhat.com>
---
 tools/perf/trace/beauty/ioctl.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/tools/perf/trace/beauty/ioctl.c b/tools/perf/trace/beauty/ioctl.c
index 52242fa4072b..e19eb6ea361d 100644
--- a/tools/perf/trace/beauty/ioctl.c
+++ b/tools/perf/trace/beauty/ioctl.c
@@ -21,7 +21,7 @@
 static size_t ioctl__scnprintf_tty_cmd(int nr, int dir, char *bf, size_t size)
 {
 	static const char *ioctl_tty_cmd[] = {
-	"TCGETS", "TCSETS", "TCSETSW", "TCSETSF", "TCGETA", "TCSETA", "TCSETAW",
+	[_IOC_NR(TCGETS)] = "TCGETS", "TCSETS", "TCSETSW", "TCSETSF", "TCGETA", "TCSETA", "TCSETAW",
 	"TCSETAF", "TCSBRK", "TCXONC", "TCFLSH", "TIOCEXCL", "TIOCNXCL", "TIOCSCTTY",
 	"TIOCGPGRP", "TIOCSPGRP", "TIOCOUTQ", "TIOCSTI", "TIOCGWINSZ", "TIOCSWINSZ",
 	"TIOCMGET", "TIOCMBIS", "TIOCMBIC", "TIOCMSET", "TIOCGSOFTCAR", "TIOCSSOFTCAR",
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an off-by-one error in the tty ioctl beauty table, where the entry for TCGETS was incorrectly starting at index 0x5400 instead of 0x5401. This led to the incorrect reporting of the ioctl command in the perf trace output, specifically showing TCSETS instead of the correct TCGETS when tracing the isatty(3) function.

    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.
